what: SpareCode is a small MIT-licensed command-line coding harness. It sends one bounded coding task to a low-cost hosted or local model and produces a reviewable diff.
audience: Developers who want a low-cost coding fallback that needs no Codex or Claude subscription.
landing_job: No landing page exists. The README opens the project and gives install and run commands.

identity.look: No visual identity. The project is a terminal tool with no web pages, stylesheets, fonts, colour tokens or logo files.

notes: Scan found 0 text files (evidence JSON). I checked by hand: git ls-files shows only Python, shell, YAML and Markdown. No html, css, svg or image files. Grep for colour, font, logo and hex values found nothing. No design-system URL in the repo.
